# Almost simple groups are generated by 3 elements (Kourovka 11.27)

Let $S$ be a finite
non-abelian simple group, identified with its inner automorphism group
$\mathrm{Inn}(S) \le \mathrm{Aut}(S)$. Every subgroup $G$ of $\mathrm{Aut}(S)$ containing $S$ is
generated by at most $3$ elements.

Dalla Volta and Lucchini proved this using the classification of finite simple groups.

## Sources

- E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), Unsolved Problems in Group Theory: The Kourovka Notebook, 21st issue, arXiv:1401.0300v49 (2026), Archive of Solved Problems, Problem 11.27 (K. Gruenberg); resolution: F. Dalla Volta and A. Lucchini, J. Algebra 178, no. 1 (1995), 194-223, Kourovka Archive, Problem 11.27: "The number `d(G)` is found (mod CFSG) for every such a group `G`. In particular, `d(G) = max {2, d(G/S)}` and `d(G) ≤ 3`", https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v49.
